items.name: DataFusionDataReader
items.summary: A DataFusion-backed reader wrapping the existing `DeltaScanNext` provider. It carries its own session so it can also satisfy [`DeltaDataReader`].

methods.name: try_new

methods.summary: Build a reader for `table`, registering the table's object store with `session` (idempotent) and resolving the `DeltaScanNext` provider.
